label: People on the Bill (headshots + names)
description: The people a film names -- webinar hosts, speakers, guests, a team -- each a round headshot (brand ring) and a white name card that flows in on the word that names them. Give every person an `at` and anchor it to their name ({"people[0].at": {"word": "Scott"}}). layout 'stack' (default: one under another, photo left of the card -- a lower band on a tall frame) or 'row' (side by side, card under the photo). Fills its box: a stack shares the height, a row the width. A face cut from a bigger picture (a flyer, a team photo) takes crop {x, y, w, h} as fractions of the source. Up to 4 people. Over footage keep it off the face. Example: {"people":[{"name":"Scott Murtaugh","title":"Founder, Growth Process Automation","src":"/assets/.../scott.jpg","at":1.3},{"name":"Max Davish","title":"Co-Founder & CTO, Quotient","src":"/assets/.../max.jpg","at":2.2}]}.

people.label: [{ name, title?, src?, at?, crop?: {x, y, w, h} }] -- one per person, in the order they are named

at.label: When the first person arrives if they have no `at` (s, default 0.3); the rest follow 0.5 s apart

exit_at.label: When they leave (s; omitted: they hold to the cut)
